sam_cs: LighthouseRx will ramp traffic tomorrow AM. They requested a temporary APAC QPS bump + IP allowlist on their peered egress. Can we fast-track?

nora_ops: Yes. Need exact CIDRs, desired qps, region, and duration. Also include reason for audit.

sam_cs: Sent list: 52.14.22.0/24, 52.14.23.12/32. Change: ap-southeast-1 from 50 -> 300 QPS for 72h. Reason: phased feature rollout; avoids 429s during pilot. Also asked about KV pre-warm for top prefixes.

jiang_eng: I'll prepare the rate-limiter patch and schedule auto-revoke at +72h. Staging test command: ```redwoodctl customers update --id lighthouse-rx --allowlist 52.14.22.0/24,52.14.23.12 --qps 300 --region ap-southeast-1 --revoke-in 72h```

nora_ops: I'll run it in staging, smoke test, then do a short prod window. Need sanitized prod payload for runbook.

sam_cs: Prod payload (sanitized): { "customer_id":"lighthouse-rx","change":{"region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":300,"allowlist":["52.14.22.0/24","52.14.23.12/32"],"auto_revoke":"72h"},"requested_by":"sam_cs" }

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change-request created (#CS-7892) by nora_ops - awaiting infra approval

jiang_eng: Staging applied; synthetic loads look good. Scheduling prod at 10:00 UTC in ~15m. Post-change checks: QPS, 5xx ratio, p99 tail. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or error rate spikes > baseline +0.5%.

nora_ops: Executed prod change at 10:03 UTC, control plane returned revoke timestamp (2026-04-02T10:03:00Z). CLI output truncated in runbook.

sam_cs: Customer confirms traffic flowing. 5xx ~0.2%, latency in SLO. I'll run KV cache warmup for top prefixes now.

emma_renewals: I'll do a renewal touchpoint today, share dashboard and recommend KPI path to Dedicated. Renewal in ~29 days; keep momentum to reduce risk.

sam_cs: Action items: 1) confirm auto-revoke executes (nora_ops), 2) publish KB for KV pre-warm + attach to ticket (sam_cs), 3) renewal outreach (emma_renewals). Closing unless issues.
